items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician’s Claude-Assisted Riemann Hypothesis Proof Certified by Lean and Mathlib Communities
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic數學家Claude輔助黎曼猜想證明獲Lean與Mathlib社群認證
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge released on November 20 a Lean formalization of a claimed proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (and generalized version for Dirichlet L-functions), developed over about six weeks working with Claude. The Lean and Mathlib communities, endorsed by the Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative, subsequently certified both the statement and the proof as correct after independent kernel and comparator checks on the roughly 17-million-line library.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic數學家Levent Alpöge於11月20日釋出與Claude合作約六週完成的黎曼猜想（及狄利克雷L函數廣義版本）Lean形式化證明。Lean與Mathlib社群（獲Lean FRO與Mathlib Initiative背書）經獨立核心與比較器檢查約1700萬行程式庫後，認證陳述與證明正確。
items_flat.analysis_en: Machine verification of a multi-million-line formalization marks a practical advance in AI-assisted mathematics, shifting the bottleneck from checking correctness to human understanding of the argument. Independent community certification strengthens the claim, though a human-readable write-up and prize-committee review remain pending.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 機器驗證數百萬行程式碼的形式化證明標誌AI輔助數學的實用進展，瓶頸從正確性檢查轉向人類對論證的理解。獨立社群認證強化主張，但人類可讀寫作與獎項委員會審查仍待完成。
items_flat.quote: We have full confidence that Alpöge’s proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct. We hereby certify that both the statement and the proof of the Riemann Hypothesis are correct.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們完全相信Alpöge的黎曼猜想證明是正確的。我們特此認證黎曼猜想的陳述與證明皆正確。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes Shared Perplexity-Based Limits on Frontier AI Development
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI首席科學家提議以Perplexity為基礎的前沿AI開發共享限制
items_flat.summary_en: On November 22, OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published “Perplexity and Intelligence,” disclosing internal log-perplexity figures (GPT-3.5 ~0.99, GPT-4 ~0.91, recent models below 0.8, a math-capable model ~0.76) on a held-out codebase dataset. He proposes common limits that labs would not cross until AI behavior monitoring reaches a concrete milestone, with further transformative capabilities expected in the ~0.68-0.70 window as soon as 2027; Altman endorsed the post as among OpenAI’s most important recent publications.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月22日，OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki發表《Perplexity and Intelligence》，公開內部log-perplexity數據（GPT-3.5約0.99、GPT-4約0.91、近期模型低於0.8、數學模型約0.76）。他提議實驗室不應跨越共同限制，直到AI行為監控達具體里程碑，並預期0.68-0.70區間最早2027年出現進一步變革能力；Altman稱此文為近期最重要發表之一。
items_flat.analysis_en: Publishing concrete pretraining metrics creates a potential cross-lab yardstick for pacing, but the proposal’s effectiveness depends on other labs adopting comparable measurements and agreeing on monitoring milestones; comparison challenges across different datasets and the fact that post-training elicitation does not reduce perplexity remain open issues.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開具體預訓練指標提供跨實驗室節奏衡量的潛在標準，但提案成效取決於其他實驗室採用可比較測量並同意監控里程碑；不同數據集比較困難，以及後訓練引出不降低perplexity仍為未決問題。
items_flat.quote: I further propose common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我進一步提議以perplexity及其他測量為基礎的共同限制，開發者承諾在我們理解與監控AI行為的能力達到某一具體里程碑之前不跨越。
